description: PTCP - CARATTERI AMBIENTALI DI LAGHI, BACINI E CORSI D'ACQUA (Art.17), INVASI ED ALVEI DEI CORSI D'ACQUA (Art.18) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provincia.fe.it. LEVEL BELONGING TO THE TERRITORIAL PLAN OF PROVINCE COORDINATION. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTCP - ENVIRONMENTAL CHARACTERISTICS OF LAKES, BATHS AND WATER COURSES (Art.17), WATER COURSES INVASI AND ALVEI (Art.18)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2005-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
